description: Software engineering around a non-deterministic, expensive, attackable component. Most quality, cost and risk lives in the decisions around the model.
Model, context, harness, loop, evaluation and governance: independent decisions every AI feature makes, plus the human layer of agentic engineering.
Building software with coding agents while the engineer keeps ownership of architecture, correctness and review.
The last lesson of each module: an Architecture Decision Record for a product briefing, checked for structure and coherence. Together they form a portfolio for the capstone.

Constela Mission's deterministic provider (`@dojo/ai`). It reproduces classes of model behavior (phrasings, malformed JSON, refusals, truncation, errors) so tests grade how code handles models in general.
Runs a test body across many seeded variations of the fake model, so code must survive every phrasing and failure order, reproducibly.
`established`, `emerging` or `hype-watch`: how settled a technique or term is.
A model name, price, limit or benchmark score that changes every few months. The lessons teach the mechanism and leave the number to your provider's documentation.
